title: SSC exam scam | save students
description:
For lakhs of Indian students, government exams are the only hope for a secure future. But what happens when the system itself is rigged? From SSC to UPSC, BPSC to SI Rajasthan, every major exam has faced scams, leaks, or corruption.

Question papers sold like business deals, fake candidates appearing in place of real ones, and powerful coaching mafias manipulating the process—the dream of a government job is being crushed by fraud.

In this video, we expose how India’s exam system is failing its youth, and why no one is being held accountable.
